title: Thunder visita os Spurs em 20 de outubro: Três pontos para acompanhar na estreia
description: Horário, contexto e um guia simples para entender a criação das jogadas, os rebotes e a transição em Oklahoma City x San Antonio.

sections.heading: Por que acompanhar a revanche
paragraphs: The Spurs eliminated the 64-win Thunder 4–3 in the 2026 Western Conference finals, making this opening-night rematch more than a generic star matchup. The latest five games of that series are listed below.
10/21 10:30 KST · Frost Bank Center · 2026–27 NBA season opener.

sections.heading: Ataque e defesa da última temporada
paragraphs: OKC finished 64–18 and averaged 119.0 scored, 107.9 allowed per game; SAS finished 62–20, 119.8 scored, 111.5 allowed. San Antonio scored slightly more while Oklahoma City conceded substantially fewer. Both dimensions matter, not just an invented 'strength rating'.
bullets: Opponent points per game: OKC 107.9 / SAS 111.5

sections.heading: Cinco confrontos recentes
paragraphs: The latest five official head-to-head matches include a 4–3 playoff series won by San Antonio. The teams' last ten 2025–26 regular-season games were OKC 7–3 and SAS 8–2. This is historic form, not current preseason form.

sections.heading: Modelo e limitações
paragraphs: Reference probabilities are calculated only from prior-season win fractions. Injuries, lineups, transfers, home-court advantage and current form are excluded. The numbers are not calibrated forecasts or betting odds.
bullets: P(home) = [home win% × away loss%] / ([home win% × away loss%] + [away win% × home loss%])
